criteria: Literal equation, label and current source digest agree with direct allowed source.
Only accepted memory IDs actually present in the exact packet are used.
One source identity, explicit limitations and exact accepted proposal provenance remain reviewable.
objective: Produce one small JSON recall card from the accepted exact frozen packet.

required_fields.accepted_memory_ids: IDs of every accepted memory document in this packet; none from the current execution
required_fields.accepted_proposal: exact registered senior proposal reference when implemented
required_fields.equation: literal equation text from the TeX source
required_fields.evidence_identity: single source identity; do not count representations as independent support
required_fields.limitations: nonempty literal extraction and fixture scope limits

revision_policy: A later candidate correction and material accepted-memory change must invalidate affected reviews and acceptance before implementation.
